def VTask.subtypePreimage : {α : Sort u_1} -> {β : Sort u_4} -> (p : α → Prop) -> [DecidablePred p] -> (x₀ : { a // p a } → β) -> { x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ } ≃ ({ a // ¬p a } → β) :=
  fun α β p hp x₀ =>
    {
      have h_forward : {x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀} → ({a // ¬p a} → β) := by
        intro ⟨x, hx⟩
        refine' fun ⟨a, ha⟩ => _
        have h₁ : x a = x₀ ⟨a, _⟩ := by
          have h₂ : x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ := hx
          have h₃ : (x ∘ Subtype.val) ⟨a, ha⟩ = x₀ ⟨a, ha⟩ := by rw [h₂]
          simpa [Subtype.val_mk] using h₃
        simpa [Subtype.val_mk] using h₁
  
      have h_backward : ({a // ¬p a} → β) → {x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀} := by
        intro y
        have h₁ : ∃ (x : α → β), x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ ∧ ∀ (a : α), ¬p a → x a = y ⟨a, by simpa using ‹_›⟩ := by
          classical
          use fun a => if h : p a then x₀ ⟨a, h⟩ else y ⟨a, by simpa using h⟩
          constructor
          · -- Prove that x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀
            ext ⟨a, ha⟩
            simp [Subtype.val_mk, hp]
            <;> aesop
          · -- Prove that for all a, ¬p a → x a = y ⟨a, ‹_›⟩
            intro a ha
            by_cases h : p a
            · exfalso
              exact ha h
            · simp [h]
              <;> aesop
        obtain ⟨x, hx, hx'⟩ := h₁
        exact ⟨x, hx⟩
  
      have h_forward_backward : ∀ (y : {a // ¬p a} → β), h_forward (h_backward y) = y := by
        intro y
        have h₁ : h_forward (h_backward y) = y := by
          have h₂ : h_backward y = ⟨fun a => if h : p a then x₀ ⟨a, h⟩ else y ⟨a, by simpa using h⟩, _⟩ := by
            -- Prove that the function constructed is indeed the extension of y to all α
            have h₃ : (fun a => if h : p a then x₀ ⟨a, h⟩ else y ⟨a, by simpa using h⟩) ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ := by
              ext ⟨a, ha⟩
              by_cases h₄ : p a
              · simp [h₄, Subtype.val_mk, hp]
                <;> aesop
              · simp [h₄, Subtype.val_mk, hp]
                <;> aesop
            -- Use the fact that the function is the extension of y to all α
            have h₄ : h_backward y = ⟨fun a => if h : p a then x₀ ⟨a, h⟩ else y ⟨a, by simpa using h⟩, h₃⟩ := by
              -- Prove that the function is the extension of y to all α
              simp [h_backward, h₃]
              <;> aesop
            rw [h₄]
          rw [h₂]
          funext ⟨a, ha⟩
          by_cases h₅ : p a
          · exfalso
            exact ha h₅
          · simp [h₅, Subtype.val_mk, hp]
            <;> aesop
        exact h₁
  
      have h_backward_forward : ∀ (⟨x, hx⟩ : {x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀}), h_backward (h_forward ⟨x, hx⟩) = ⟨x, hx⟩ := by
        intro ⟨x, hx⟩
        have h₁ : h_backward (h_forward ⟨x, hx⟩) = ⟨x, hx⟩ := by
          have h₂ : h_forward ⟨x, hx⟩ = fun ⟨a, ha⟩ => x a := by
            simp [h_forward]
          rw [h₂]
          have h₃ : h_backward (fun ⟨a, ha⟩ => x a) = ⟨x, hx⟩ := by
            have h₄ : (fun ⟨a, ha⟩ => x a) ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ := by
              have h₅ : x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ := hx
              ext ⟨a, ha⟩
              simp [Subtype.val_mk, hp] at h₅ ⊢
              <;> aesop
            have h₅ : h_backward (fun ⟨a, ha⟩ => x a) = ⟨x, hx⟩ := by
              have h₆ : h_backward (fun ⟨a, ha⟩ => x a) = ⟨fun a => x a, by simpa using h₄⟩ := by
                simp [h_backward]
                <;> aesop
              rw [h₆]
              <;> aesop
            exact h₅
          exact h₃
        exact h₁
  
      {
        constructor
        · intro ⟨x, hx⟩
          exact h_forward ⟨x, hx⟩
        · intro y
          exact h_backward y
        · intro y
          exact h_forward_backward y
        · intro ⟨x, hx⟩
          exact h_backward_forward ⟨x, hx⟩
      }
    }
